attributes.board_name: New Hampshire Board of Dental Examiners (Office of Professional Licensure and Certification)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses sponsored/approved by ADA and its societies, AGD, ADHA and its societies, state/local dental or hygiene associations, dental/medical/hygiene schools, hospitals, government health agencies, postgraduate schools; specialty board maintenance courses; up to 75% online/audio-visual/live webinar; up to 10% for ADA/AGD/ADHA meeting attendance. Board does not pre-approve courses.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first biennial renewal after initial licensure following graduation.
rules.alternatives: Waiver petition for severe illness, incapacity or other hardship. Passing the written ADEX or similar clinical exam counts for 100% of the CEUs.
rules.audit_note: Attest on the renewal addendum; keep certificates 3 years; audits per Plc 308.04(d).

topics.who: Course including CDC infection prevention and control guidelines

rules.notes: Per biennium: at least 15 CEUs clinical, 2 CEUs medical emergency training, hands-on BLS-HCP (counts 3 CEUs). EFDA-qualified hygienists need 10 extra CEUs in restorative dentistry.
rules.legal_basis: N.H. Admin. Rules Den 401, Den 406; RSA 317-A:12, XI
